clause: ( {33489} ( ( {33489} ( daily macd histogram( 26,24,25 ) > 0 and 1 day ago macd histogram( 26,24,25 ) < 0 ) ) or( {33489} ( daily macd histogram( 26,24,25 ) < 0 and 1 day ago macd histogram( 26,24,25 ) > 0 ) ) ) )

name: Weekly RSI > 70
clause: ( {57960} ( weekly rsi( 14 ) > 70 and 1 week ago rsi( 14 ) < 70 ) )

name: New ATh
